newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil, Nissho win tender to develop Qatar oil.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil, Nissho win tender to develop Qatar oil.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it, Nissho Iwai Corp and the United Petroleum Development Co Ltd had signed a production-sharing contract with Qatar for an off-shore oil field.

Cosmo said in a statement that it plans to begin commercial production of crude oil from 2000 if operations progress smoothly and that it expected peak production to reach 8,000 barrels-per-day (bpd).
The area to be developed is Block 1SE, west of the El Bundug oil field.
The concession covers about 300 square kilometres to a depth of 20 metres, the statement said.
The contract will be for 25 years.
"Test drilling has already been conducted and we've confirmed there are oil reserves there," a Cosmo spokesman said.
This is the first time an all-Japanese consortium has signed a production sharing contract with a Gulf oil producer since the 1973 oil crisis, Cosmo said in the statement.
